Spotlight: Took a massive rise in the ratings (23lb) for back-to-back wins at Fairyhouse and the Curragh in July, showing a liking for quick ground; struggled in her hat-trick bid on easier going at Galway.

RaceName: CSG Rated Race
Spotlight: Won an AW maiden over this trip last winter; good form on first two starts this term on turf, over 1m at Naas and 1m2f at Navan; not as good at the Curragh next time; beaten favourite for a second time when second over 1m at Leopardstown; has achieved a fair standard all the same.

RaceName: CSG Rated Race
Spotlight: Frankel filly; promising in two AW runs in Britain last winter; stays further than this; rating seems fair enough

RaceName: CSG Rated Race
Spotlight: Claimed after Naas success last September; pleasing yard debut when second in Leopardstown nursery; seemingly ridden to stay 1m2f trip on return at Roscommon in late June, staying on into fourth; did not get the best of runs when well supported at Galway; tongue-tie on now, leading chance.

RaceName: CSG Rated Race
Spotlight: Dismal effort on seasonal debut over 1m2f on soft-to-heavy at the Curragh; transformed when beating Elmakaya over 1m on good ground at Naas in May; slightly concerning that she has not run since then, while the runner-up has garnered more experience.

RaceName: CSG Rated Race
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan
Spotlight: Wootton Bassett filly made some late headway on debut at Leopardstown; perhaps a little unlucky not to peg back a front-running Totally Puzzle at Naas in May; confirmed maiden-winning potential with third of 19 at the same venue; not quite as good at Gowran last time.

RaceName: Robert Gilbert Birthday Celebration Irish EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Had a subsequent nursery winner back in second when winning at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) on debut in June; came up short at Newcastle last month and progress will be needed to take this.

RaceName: Robert Gilbert Birthday Celebration Irish EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Recorded RPRs in the 50s in his two runs this summer, beaten nearly 8l at Newmarket 15 days ago; should do better at some point but perhaps when nurseries are on the agenda.

RaceName: Robert Gilbert Birthday Celebration Irish EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Useful pedigree but he made a modest start to his career when sixth of seven, beaten 13l, in a 6f novice at Newmarket (good to firm; over 5l behind Hello You Ten); should do better at some point.

RaceName: Robert Gilbert Birthday Celebration Irish EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Down the field at Ascot (7f, good to firm) on debut but that was a strong race and he took a step forward when second of five at Hamilton (6f, good; form handsomely franked on Wednesday); still has more to offer and he's one of the likelier types.

RaceName: Robert Gilbert Birthday Celebration Irish EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Second foal; dam 5f winner (RPR 62), closely related to winners Acolyte (useful 6f including 2yo) and Amplify (5f/6f), out of unraced sister to 1m2f/1m4f winner Night Orbit; by Mayson so rain shouldn't be an issue; betting to guide.

RaceName: Robert Gilbert Birthday Celebration Irish EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 12-1, slowly away and never in contention in a 7f maiden at Kempton 11 days ago; stable may have stronger claims with Hello You Ten.

RaceName: Robert Gilbert Birthday Celebration Irish EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Good second on her debut at Bath (5f, good) in June but she failed to build on it at Newbury (6f, good to firm) seven weeks ago; capable of better and she holds each-way claims.

RaceName: Robert Gilbert Birthday Celebration Irish EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Promising fourth at Ripon on debut and stepped forward with her easy win at Lingfield (6f, good to firm) four weeks ago; the third from that race has won since; more to come and she's the one to beat.

RaceName: Robert Gilbert Birthday Celebration Irish EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Third foal; dam 6f winner (including AW; RPR 83), half-sister to 7f 2yo/1m1f winner In First Place; rare 2yo runner for the stable.

RaceName: Robert Gilbert Birthday Celebration Irish EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 100-1 when well beaten in a 7f novice at Newbury on Saturday; now tried in a hood; should do better at some point.

RaceName: Robert Gilbert Birthday Celebration Irish EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Sixth foal; half-brother to 5f AW winner Lunasa (including 2yo; RPR 63); dam unraced sister to 6f/1m winner Royal Silk; stable also represented by Fillipas.

RaceName: Robert Gilbert Birthday Celebration Irish EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Second foal; dam placed 7f-8.6f (including AW; RPR 78), half-sister to French 1m2f winner Philaminte; unlikely winner on debut.

RaceName: Robert Gilbert Birthday Celebration Irish EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 1,400gns yearling; sixth foal; dam placed 1m6f AW (RPR 51), closely related to German 6.5f 2yo Listed winner Gooseley Lane (second dam of smart sprinter Goken); rare 2yo runner for Seamus Mullins.

RaceName: Tom Lynam Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Two hurdle wins at 2m2f but has lost her way since Listowel novice chase win in September; others in better form.

RaceName: Tom Lynam Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: C&D winner off 2lb lower last year (yielding); form since then doesn't excite too much but she was better reverted to hurdles over C&D last time when taking the runner-up spot in first-time cheekpieces; place chance.

RaceName: Tom Lynam Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Made the breakthrough at the eighth time of asking under rules (sixth in maiden hurdles) when beating Facile Ocean by 1.75l over C&D last time (good); runner-up won by 14l next time; mark looks fair enough for handicap bow and Dan King rides again; a lot to like.

RaceName: Tom Lynam Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Came home 7l to the good in a 2m3f handicap at Cork (2m3f, good) before failing to complete her two latest starts at Listowel (3m, good to yielding) and back at Cork (2m4f, good); hard to trust after that.

RaceName: Tom Lynam Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a Ballinrobe maiden hurdle by 16l last summer (2m3f, good); put some underwhelming efforts behind her back at the scene of her win last time when a 3.75l runner-up (2m2f, good); can be hit or miss and up 2lb.

RaceName: Tom Lynam Memorial Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: Treaty Retail Invest' Holdings Ltd/Denis Murphy B'stock Ltd
Spotlight: Runner-up in three maiden hurdles (including here) last summer; made a positive return to action at Limerick in May when a 10l third (2m4f, soft) but didn't find the expected improvement back there last time (2m4f, good, 5-2)) when beaten 22l; must bounce back.

RaceName: Tom Lynam Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Three-time chase winner, including at Killarney in May (3m2f, good to yielding) is 0-6 over hurdles so has a 24lb lower mark in this discipline; hasn't contested a hurdle race since 2024 and never for this yard so he looks like a huge danger to all off this mark but this trip looks tight for him.

RaceName: Tom Lynam Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won over 2m here on stable debut in May off 98 (good to yielding); didn't back it up at Killarney next time, but a bit more promise when ninth at Ballinrobe last time; others preferred.

RaceName: Tom Lynam Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Has finished third in all three 2m1f handicaps to date on good ground; raised 3lb for her Galway effort last time when closing late on in a first-time tongue tie (retained); Dan King rode her that day but today sticks with Mysilverriverveale; shortlisted all the same.

RaceName: Tom Lynam Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a novice handicap at Galway in October but struggled since and was beaten 23l in a Galway handicap last time (2m6f, good).

RaceName: Tom Lynam Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a Downpatrick maiden hurdle last year for John McConnell; no show in opening two starts for this yard, but her runner-up finish at Cork last time was much better (2m2f, good); Jack Kennedy remains aboard and cheekpieces go on; not ruled out.

RaceName: Tom Lynam Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Placed in two maiden hurdles last summer but this years form has been poor; third of 18 in a maiden hurdle at Cork (2m2f, good) last time, but he was 23l behind the winner; needs to build on that to get involved.

RaceName: Tom Lynam Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Best form has come at Downpatrick (although lightly raced away from there); coasted 12l clear over 2m2f there last time (good) in first-time blinkers; got an easy lead that day in a lower grade at his favourite track, so may not find it so simple to repeat.

RaceName: Tom Lynam Memorial Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: Eamon Nolan & Mrs Catherine Anne Nolan
Spotlight: Fine 1l second on handicap debut at Limerick in March (2m, soft); didn't quite see ou the 2m4f at Wexford (good to yielding); stamina doubts not disproven here last time (2m5f, good) when mistakes and being hampered also played a role in a moderate showing; dropped 2lb and Mark Walsh rides for the first time.

RaceName: Tom Lynam Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won over C&D in May off 87 (good to yielding); bounced back from a poor Killarney run back here over 2m last time when denied by a neck (2m, good); up 3lb more now but the claimer negates that and he likes it around here.

RaceName: Tom Lynam Memorial Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Produced a much-improved effort on third hurdle start here last time (2m, good to yielding); check market for his handicap debut.

RaceName: Scullion Law Lanark Silver Bell Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Four-time turf winner at up to 1m2f (good/good to soft), latest at Ayr last September; best of three runs this season when third at Southwell last time (1m3f); quite interesting on first try at 1m4f.

RaceName: Scullion Law Lanark Silver Bell Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Has won four of his 11 races, the latest by 6l at Goodwood in May (1m2f, good; made all); hit with a 12lb rise for that and below par since; stays 1m4f, has been dropped 4lb and tongue-tie now tried; bit to prove.

RaceName: Scullion Law Lanark Silver Bell Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: Akela Thoroughbreds Ltd & Jinky Farms II
Spotlight: Bought for 165,000euros in July last year having won twice in France, the second a 1m2f Listed event at Saint-Cloud; well below par on both starts for new yard last year (reportedly finished lame on second occasion); returns after a 330-day break with a hood tried; bit to prove.

RaceName: Scullion Law Lanark Silver Bell Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Ex-William Haggas; followed up his easy Leicester win in June (1m2f, good; made virtually all) by finishing runner-up off a 10lb higher mark at Goodwood last month; up another 3lb and tries 1m4f for the first time; interesting.

RaceName: Scullion Law Lanark Silver Bell Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Four of his five wins have been on the AW, his only turf success coming at Newmarket in 2023 (1m4f, good); ran a couple of fair races on the AW earlier this year but pulled up in the Duke Of Edinburgh at Royal Ascot last time.

RaceName: Scullion Law Lanark Silver Bell Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Versatile 5yo whose latest win was a handicap hurdle at Cheltenham last November (2m5f, soft); hasn't been at his best on the Flat this year (2m-2m4f) although not beaten far in the Shergar Cup last time; not sure drop in trip will suit.

RaceName: Scullion Law Lanark Silver Bell Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Two wins over 1m2f at Ripon this year (good/good to soft) and a good second to Salamanca City (with whom he is 4lb better off) when stepped up to 1m4f there last time (good); won over 1m2f last September on only previous start here; interesting.

RaceName: Scullion Law Lanark Silver Bell Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won a five-runner handicap at Newmarket in May (1m2f, good to firm) and fair runs since, last time finishing a close third at Goodwood (1m2f, good to firm); has won on testing ground; a possible on first try at 1m4f.

RaceName: Scullion Law Lanark Silver Bell Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: In-form mare who is bidding for her fourth win this season, the third coming at Ripon last time when beating Spioradalta (now 4lb better off) by 1.5l; stays this trip well; on a career-high mark but the race should be run to suit her and she has a good chance.

RaceName: Scullion Law Lanark Silver Bell Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Ex-French; only win was in a 1m1f conditions event on testing ground as a juvenile; has run a couple of fair races for David O'Meara this term, although was 20l seventh of ten at York last time (reportedly unsuited by the fast ground); could bounce back.

RaceName: Scullion Law Lanark Silver Bell Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won four on the trot at 1m6f/2m for Charlie Johnston in 2022; has since won on AW and over hurdles; best watched on first run for Adam Nicol.

RaceName: Scullion Law Lanark Silver Bell Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won over 1m2f at Ayr in July (good) and excuses for two heavy defeats since; can take a keen hold, so not sure to be suited by this step up to 1m4f.

RaceName: Scullion Law Lanark Silver Bell Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won first two races this year, the second a 1m3f handicap here by 5l (good); mixed form since (faced a stiff task last time); each-way chance.

RaceName: Scullion Law Lanark Silver Bell Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Showed some smart form without winning last year; was rated highly, but has been dropping to a better mark and is quite interesting back in handicap company, having broken his duck in good style in a 1m3f novice here last time.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Vincent O'Brien Ruby Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Best form has come on ground with a give, landed Listed contest over this trip at Listowel in September in testing conditions; beaten 13l at this grade over 1m4f at Limerick 63 days ago; drop in trip fine but up probably up against it on good ground.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Vincent O'Brien Ruby Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Not won since his Madrid Handicap success 18 months ago at Naas (7f, soft) but has run some fine races, most notably when second to Diego Velazquez on good at the Curragh last year and filled the same spot behind Big Gossey on soft in the Gladness in March; well below form last time on firm; highest-rated in the field but may need ground to soften up before he's at his best.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Vincent O'Brien Ruby Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Three-time winner over 1m on varying ground; ran to best when beaten 2l in Galway handicap last month; wide trip at same venue 19 days ago; should be thereabouts.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Vincent O'Brien Ruby Stakes (Listed Race)
OwnerName: AMO Racing Limited & Giselle De Aguiar
Spotlight: Four-time AW winner but has bettered that form on turf this year when second in Group 2 at the Curragh (1m, good) and beaten 5.5l in Duke Of Cambridge; step up in trip didn't suit in Pretty Polly last time; front-runner and dangerous if allowed dictate.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Vincent O'Brien Ruby Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Has some good Group form in Germany and ran okay on Irish debut when beaten 5l in Leopardstown Group 2; detached last at the Curragh last time, however, so hard to have confidence in.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Vincent O'Brien Ruby Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Three-time handicap winner over 7f; career-best 14 days ago when second to Rebel Wave giving away 15lb; up against it in this company however and ran to freely on last attempt at 1m.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Vincent O'Brien Ruby Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Won a 1m2f Curragh maiden in September (yielding to soft) before good third in Listed event at Gowran Park (9.5f, good); consistent but well-held in three stakes races since; down in trip and needs more.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Vincent O'Brien Ruby Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Three-time handicap winner on testing ground over 1m to 1m2f last year; clear career-best when second to subsequent Group 3-winning stablemate in Listed race at Navan (1m, good); close to matching that effort when beaten 7l into fourth in Meld Stakes 36 days ago; strong pace in front would help and each-way chance.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Vincent O'Brien Ruby Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Smart form as a 2yo, bolted up in Leopardstown maiden (1m, yielding/soft) before 5l second to Benvenuto Cellini in Group 2; opened season with easy conditions race win at Naas (1m, soft) and decent efforts in defeat since; fourth at Galway 24 days ago a solid effort in first-time cheekpieces but needs to reverse form with Jagged Edge off same terms; tongue-tie goes on.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Vincent O'Brien Ruby Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Third in strong maiden at Naas (1m, good) before going two places better over same C&D, defeating White Sand Beach by 1l; not seen to best effect when beaten 1l into fourth on handicap debut at Galway but still needs a plenty more at this level.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Vincent O'Brien Ruby Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Nine-race maiden who has ran solid races over a variety of trips but likely to be found wanting at this level; yard won this last year.

RaceName: Andy Hardwick & Clive Leonard Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Has won on turf but this season's best efforts, notably when second at Newcastle on Good Friday, have come on AW; slow starts have been an issue on last two starts; talented but risky.

RaceName: Andy Hardwick & Clive Leonard Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Wide-margin win in a Ripon novice on her reappearance and followed up in a C&D handicap last month (only three ran); well beaten at Glorious Goodwood 24 days ago but could resume her progress back in calmer waters.

RaceName: Andy Hardwick & Clive Leonard Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Improved for the switch to handicaps when winning at Windsor (6f, good to firm) in May; not quite so good twice since and needs to produce a career best.

RaceName: Andy Hardwick & Clive Leonard Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Ran well over C&D last summer before struggling in good company on his final two starts as a 2yo; no better in two runs this year and the new cheekpieces need to turn things around.

RaceName: Andy Hardwick & Clive Leonard Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: He has improved with each of his three starts, readily accounting for three rivals on his return to action at Doncaster (6f, good to firm); this will demand much more but he still has time on his side; good chance.

RaceName: Andy Hardwick & Clive Leonard Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark at the sixth attempt when dropped to 5f at Sandown in May; no impact in two subsequent runs and now steps back up a furlong.

RaceName: Andy Hardwick & Clive Leonard Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Two 5f wins this season but only four ran on the second occasion; put in his place at Glorious Goodwood last time but the return to 6f could prove beneficial.

RaceName: Peadar's Bar Moate Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Never landed a blow at Ballinrobe on debut but took the second spot at Wexford last time (3m1f, good) albeit the form doesn't amount to much; had Pacy Macie 16l behind that day; needs to improve.

RaceName: Peadar's Bar Moate Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Cost 70,000euros as a 3yo; disputing the lead when unseated five out on point-to-point debut at Necarne in May; made a positive first outing under rules when 6.25l fifth of 20 at Galway three weeks ago (2m6f, good); repeat of that would likely be enough and this extra trip should help too.

RaceName: Peadar's Bar Moate Maiden Hurdle
OwnerName: A Cahill, M Dowd, P Glancy Partnership
Spotlight: Bought for 40,000GBP after winning a point in 2025; however, has struggled badly in a Sligo bumper and a Roscommon maiden hurdle, beaten 78l in the latter race; questions to answer now.

RaceName: Peadar's Bar Moate Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Runner-up in a Cork maiden hurdle last November but no sign of that form in three runs since; the tongue-tie will have to make a major difference.

RaceName: Peadar's Bar Moate Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Order Of St George gelding; dam, by Yeats, unraced half-sister to smart hurdle/chase winner Maiden In Taipan; probably of longer-term interest.

RaceName: Peadar's Bar Moate Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: 1-9 in point-to-points; poor form in first three starts over hurdles; unlikely.

RaceName: Peadar's Bar Moate Maiden Hurdle
OwnerName: Ms Margaret Nevin & Ms Alana Insole
Spotlight: Fine run when 100-1 in a 2m maiden hurdle at Ballinrobe on her debut, beaten 17l and splitting two subsequent winners; didn't improve when fifth back at Ballinrobe last time (2m2f, good); looked in need of further in both those runs and she gets it here; could go well.

RaceName: Peadar's Bar Moate Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Best effort in three point-to-points was a 13l second in April and the winner of that race has since placed in a bumper; third at Wexford (3m1f, good) on rules bow, but was 16l behind the second-placed Benner Wenner.

RaceName: Acrisure Handicap
Spotlight: Best form has been on AW, with a career high at Newcastle in January (5f); 0-12 on grass and well down the field in a Class 2 at Glorious Goodwood latest.

RaceName: Acrisure Handicap
Spotlight: Progressive as 2yo and started this year with a good 6f handicap run at Newmarket in April (good); lost his chance at the start next time but the York run last time is harder to forgive; fair mark if he could rediscover his best form.

RaceName: Acrisure Handicap
Spotlight: Ex-Irish 4yo; has steadily found his form for current yard and wasn't disgraced at a higher level last time at Ascot; could go well as he handles any conditions.

RaceName: Acrisure Handicap
Spotlight: Won three times last autumn (5f, AW/good to soft) and has run some solid races in defeat this year, including at Goodwood (soft) latest 75 days ago; a positive jockey booking and the recent rain was welcomed.

RaceName: Acrisure Handicap
Spotlight: Has done well since the blinkers went on but appears to have no margin for error off this mark, 2lb above his win in May; behind two of these here last time.

RaceName: Acrisure Handicap
OwnerName: B Jordan, Brian Jordan, S Jordan & N McConnell
Spotlight: Had first-time cheekpieces (retained) when making all at Ayr (5f, good to firm) a month ago for his first win in a while; put back up 4lb but still has handicapping scope if the headgear works again.

RaceName: Acrisure Handicap
Spotlight: Without a win since last season's Portland handicap at Doncaster (good) off this very mark; races prominently and rallied for second here last time; clear claims, for all that she's one of a few who might want to be up there early.

RaceName: Acrisure Handicap
OwnerName: M McHale, J Munroe, M Guy & D Walshe
Spotlight: Four wins last season; on a competitive mark and under usual prominent tactics he hung around for a close fourth here 20 days ago; enters the reckoning.

RaceName: Acrisure Handicap
Spotlight: Made all over C&D in June and runner-up on his next two starts; below his best last time at Ayr but a revival would come as no surprise.

RaceName: Acrisure Handicap
Spotlight: Most wins on the AW but able on turf and stayed on well for second here 20 days ago (good; might not prefer it softer); this is a better race but he'll appreciate chasing a strong pace if ground conditions are suitable; 2lb out of the weights.

RaceName: Acrisure Handicap
Spotlight: Has not been in the best of form and can't afford to be 5lb out of the weights.

RaceName: T1 Healthcare Handicap
Spotlight: AW maiden winner over this trip last year; ran a decent race over C&D when beaten 3l into fifth last month but followed it with poor run at Galway lto; visor tried.

RaceName: T1 Healthcare Handicap
Spotlight: Showed promise in on debut on AW over 7f in September before taking a step backwards at the same venue; returned from nine months off and showed up well before fading into sixth at Curragh 34 days ago; likely to come on for that but needs to off opening mark up in trip.

RaceName: T1 Healthcare Handicap
Spotlight: Hadn't shown a great deal in four starts but took a big step in the right direction when beaten a neck at Galway (1m, yielding) 21 days ago, possibly a shade unlucky as blindsided by winner; likely to build on that and big chance off 4lb higher; stable jockey choice out of strong duo.

RaceName: T1 Healthcare Handicap
Spotlight: AW maiden winner over 7f in March; consistent in handicaps since and kept on to be beaten 3.5l into seventh in strong handicap at the Curragh 12 days ago; doesn't have loads in hand but rarely runs a bad race and has an each-way chance.

RaceName: T1 Healthcare Handicap
Spotlight: Some decent maiden form last year, particularly when third over this trip at Thurles in October; first two handicap runs only fair but really caught the eye with how he finished at Leopardstown last time when staying on strongly to grab third; step up in trip should suit on that evidence and a contender.

RaceName: T1 Healthcare Handicap
Spotlight: Easy win at Gowran Parl (9.5f, yielding) off 11lb lower in June; poor run four days later easily excused; bounced back after break at Galway last time and would have finished closer but for traffic problems (3.5l behind Casamorati); second-string for stable but can't be dismissed.

RaceName: T1 Healthcare Handicap
Spotlight: Danced in off 11lb lower at Leopardstown in June (1m, soft) and followed up with solid third in similar conditions; not so good last twice and probably needs an ease in the ground.

RaceName: T1 Healthcare Handicap
Spotlight: Cosy winner at Gowran Park (7f, soft) in April off 9lb lower; ran with credit three times since, including over C&D last time when beaten 2.5l into fourth; others probably better treated, however.

RaceName: T1 Healthcare Handicap
Spotlight: Hasn't gone on from promising enough debut at Limerick (7f, yielding) in April; couldn't land a blow on handicap debut; gelded and off 70 days; cheekpieces and tongue-tie reached for.

RaceName: T1 Healthcare Handicap
Spotlight: AW nursery winner in December; yet to match that form in three turf starts; 12th at Galway last time and plenty to find with the O'Brien-trained pair on that effort.

RaceName: Cara Glass Handicap
Spotlight: 7f win here 12 months ago; placed in two of her four runs this year, the latest at Windsor 25 days ago; decent chance provided the ground doesn't get too testing.

RaceName: Cara Glass Handicap
Spotlight: Won a 7f handicap at Kempton off this mark in May; off the boil more recently but the addition of cheekpieces could give her a lift.

RaceName: Cara Glass Handicap
OwnerName: The 19th Hole Syndicate & J S Moore
Spotlight: Two AW wins to his name but his turf form isn't quite of the same standard; modest fourth over C&D last week and he is due to be 2lb lower from the weekend.

RaceName: Cara Glass Handicap
Spotlight: Having edged down the weights he got off the mark at the seventh attempt with a hard-fought win at Windsor (1m, good to firm) last month; up 3lb but this isn't a strong 0-70 and he should make another bold bid.

RaceName: Cara Glass Handicap
Spotlight: Improved for the step up to 1m/switch to nurseries when winning at Leicester last October; two creditable efforts on AW last month; one to consider back on turf.

RaceName: Cara Glass Handicap
Spotlight: Promise in novice/maiden company; no improvement for the switch to handicaps when sixth of 14 at Doncaster (1m, good to soft) in May but that race didn't go entirely to plan and she returns to action with the potential for a bit better.

RaceName: Cara Glass Handicap
Spotlight: No better than midfield in three novice runs at up to 8.3f; not obviously well treated ahead of her handicap debut but this is at least a more realistic opportunity.

RaceName: Cara Glass Handicap
Spotlight: Improved efforts at Chepstow this summer, second in late May before a comfortable success seven weeks ago (both 1m, good to firm); a 3lb rise shouldn't prevent another big run.

RaceName: New Forest Estate & Golf Club Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Maiden from 15 starts but has looked on the verge of a breakthrough recently; 1.25l behind the winner when second at Limerick in May (2m4f, good to yielding) and just 0.5l behind when filling the same spot at Roscommon last time (3m1f, soft), pair pulled well clear; up 6lb in total for those two performances but big player.

RaceName: New Forest Estate & Golf Club Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Four point wins and snared a maiden hunter chase three years ago; two runs for this yard don't provide too much encouragement.

RaceName: New Forest Estate & Golf Club Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Shed his maiden tag at Wexford in May when winning a 3m handicap hurdle off 87 (good to yielding); way below that level on his handicap chase bow at Killarney (2m7f, good to yielding) last time when tailed off; stable has hit form in the meantime and blinkers go on so he might be worth another go as he had run with credit in his two beginners'.

RaceName: New Forest Estate & Golf Club Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Ended a barren spell when pouncing late at Perth in 2025 over hurdles (3m, good); best run of the season came in the same race last time when a 1.75l third of 11; 1-27 in chases, but this is just his second attempt in this low grade.

RaceName: New Forest Estate & Golf Club Handicap Chase
Spotlight: 1-16 in points but yet to make the breakthrough in 15 starts over hurdles and fences; finished 8.25l behind Fr Gilligansvoyge at Downpatrick in June; tailed off in sole completed start since.

RaceName: New Forest Estate & Golf Club Handicap Chase
Spotlight: 3-15 over hurdles but remains a maiden over fences after four runs and rated 25lb lower; ran okay off this mark at Tramore last August but lacks a recent and is best watched unless the market speaks.

RaceName: New Forest Estate & Golf Club Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Gained back-to-back wins in May, easily over fences at Limerick (2m7f, good, OR 77) and hurdles at Tramore (2m6f, good, OR 75); disappointed off his new mark in a 3m1f chase here 13 days ago when last of four and tailed off in the four-runner field; needs to bounce back.

RaceName: New Forest Estate & Golf Club Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Winless from 15 tries over hurdles; respectable efforts without threatening the last twice at Wexford; related to winning chaser O'Faolains Lad so perhaps this discipline can unlock more from him.

RaceName: New Forest Estate & Golf Club Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Dual point-to-point winner is 1-4 over fences, with the victory coming over C&D in 2024 off 4lb lower; got a first hurdles win here last year (3m1f, yielding); well beaten on seasonal return at Punchestown in May and didn't improve at Sligo last time; return to this venue could spark him.

RaceName: New Forest Estate & Golf Club Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Somehow, the veteran has found top form at the ripe age of 13; won at Downpatrick in June off 72 (3m, good) and held form well when placed twice at Wexford over 2m4f/3m1f; landed a third career success when an easy winner at Tramore last time (2m6f, good); up 6lb for that but has to be on the shortlist considering his form.

RaceName: New Forest Estate & Golf Club Handicap Chase
Spotlight: 0-15 under rules and was pulled up twice at Punchestown over hurdles and then fences before tailed off when out of her depth in a Galway beginners' last time; others preferred.

RaceName: New Forest Estate & Golf Club Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Veteran has been lightly raced in recent years, with poor form shown; new cheekpieces need to reverse the march of time.

RaceName: New Forest Estate & Golf Club Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Three-time winner but nothing since March 2024 when he won a heavy ground handicap chase at Limerick off 94 (3m1f); wasn't shaping like a winner in waiting towards the end of last season; needs to find his form but perhaps the break has done him good.

RaceName: New Forest Estate & Golf Club Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Maiden ran well enough off this mark at Down Royal (3m2f, good, 50-1) when beaten 10l in fifth; needs to find more to win.

RaceName: Patersons Of Greenoakhill Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: A fair 6f winner at Wolverhampton this spring for Jack Morland; not discredited for his new handler with third of 11 in 7f claimer at Carlisle two days ago; no forlorn hope.

RaceName: Patersons Of Greenoakhill Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Bagged a pair of 6f handicaps at Catterick and Epsom in early summer; comes here on the back of a very good nose second of eight in 6f Epsom handicap a week ago; another bold showing is on the cards off an unchanged mark.

RaceName: Patersons Of Greenoakhill Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: A four-time 5f/6f scorer in 2025; resumed from seven months off with an encouraging second of nine in 5f Sandown handicap in June; that form has worked out well, so this veteran is a likely player after another break.

RaceName: Patersons Of Greenoakhill Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Successful seven times (including over C&D) in 2025; back to winning ways at Carlisle (1m) in July but she went too freely when ninth of ten in 1m Ayr handicap 13 days ago; she's the sort to bounce back.

RaceName: Patersons Of Greenoakhill Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Scored at Leicester (6f) in April; running well since and just edged out when third of 26 in 6f Goodwood handicap 23 days ago; that form is proving very strong, so he merits serious consideration despite 2lb rise.

RaceName: Patersons Of Greenoakhill Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Gained a third C&D win in June and backed it up with a good third of 12 in 6f Southwell handicap 25 days ago; enters calculations once more.

RaceName: Patersons Of Greenoakhill Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: On a losing run but this Irish challenger arrives in good nick, not best drawn when sixth of 15 in 7f Galway handicap 24 days ago; in the mix again.

RaceName: Patersons Of Greenoakhill Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: A dual 7f winner early in 2026 and he's holding his form well, beaten a nose when second of five in 7f Ayr handicap 25 days ago; this C&D scorer can make his presence felt.

RaceName: Patersons Of Greenoakhill Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Resumed winning ways at Carlisle (6f) and not seen to ideal effect with fifth of eight over C&D later in June; this C&D scorer can't be discounted in refitted cheekpieces after a break.

RaceName: Patersons Of Greenoakhill Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Gained a first success for current yard at Ayr (7f) in May and has proved reliable since, runner-up in 11-runner handicap at Musselburgh (7f) two weeks ago; he can go well again nudged up 1lb.

RaceName: Patersons Of Greenoakhill Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: 0-11 but she was placed for the third start in a row when second of 13 in 6f Ayr handicap 13 days ago; not out of things off just a 1lb higher mark.

RaceName: Kellihers Toyota Kingdom Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: 145-rated staying hurdle, runner-up in two valuable handicaps at Aintree and Haydock in spring; second behind Gaoth Chuil in Flat maiden at Leopardstown before going one better over C&D last month; cracking handicap debut when beaten 2l in competitive race at Galway 25 days ago; 2lb rise fair and very much unexposed in this sphere.

RaceName: Kellihers Toyota Kingdom Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Versatile mare who landed a C&D maiden a year ago; good form this year, ran a cracker when second to Deressa off 4lb lower at Ballinrobe in June; Galway Hurdle run can be ignored and holds each-way chance.

RaceName: Kellihers Toyota Kingdom Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Five-time handicap winner, three on AW; latest win at Leopardstown (1m4f, good) off 7lb lower in May followed up with good run at the Curragh; always behind at Galway last time and tries new trip.

RaceName: Kellihers Toyota Kingdom Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Progressive on the Flat, landed qualified riders handicap over 2m1f here in May off 8lb lower, travelling powerfully; followed up with 1.5l second at the Curragh over this trip (Granite Bay third); found consistency come to an end but ran to bad to be true at the Curragh 54 days ago; freshened up since and big chance if can resume progress.

RaceName: Kellihers Toyota Kingdom Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Listed bumper winner; landed 1m5f Flat maiden at Down Royal last year on good; decisively scored at Gowran Park over this tirp on soft in April and didn't get the cleanest of runs at Galway last time; may need a slight ease in the ground to show best.

RaceName: Kellihers Toyota Kingdom Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Gained first win since 2023 with good attitude shown at Ballinrobe (1m5f, good) 32 days ago, defeating Truth Be Told by a neck; raised 6lb and probably not guaranteed to back that up but did run well over C&D last year.

RaceName: Kellihers Toyota Kingdom Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: All four wins, three on Flat and one over hurdles, came on soft; finished runner-up last twice in Cork Derby and competitive Galway handicap; obvious claims up in trip but might need rain before he gets his head in front again.

RaceName: Kellihers Toyota Kingdom Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Very useful hurdler and course winner on the Flat here in 2m1f handicap off 5lb lower last month, following up Leopardstown (1m7f, good-to-firm) victory over Eagle Fang; meets that rival on better terms but has to put tame effort at Galway behind her.

RaceName: Kellihers Toyota Kingdom Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Finally got head in front after 19 attempts when landing Downpatrick maiden hurdle last month and has since followed it up with a novice hurdle and chase victory; needs to prove as effective on the Flat but didn't run badly in 1m3f maiden in April on ground softer than ideal; could be on a decent mark.

RaceName: Kellihers Toyota Kingdom Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Did well to gain third win when powering home to get up by a neck at Galway (1m4f, yielding) 20 days ago; up 5lb but this trip could suit on that evidence.

RaceName: Kellihers Toyota Kingdom Gold Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Won this last year off 4lb lower; some good runs since and ran a solid race when beaten 2.25l into sixth over 1m7f at Leopardstown 15 days ago; 2-4 here so has to enter calculations.

RaceName: Signs In Motion British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 780,000euros yearling who comfortably saw off a well-touted Gosden newcomer at Wolverhampton (9.4f; 2-1); should be much too good for these even with a penalty.

RaceName: Signs In Motion British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: A very moderate hurdler these days and tailed off in her two Flat races.

RaceName: Signs In Motion British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Reportedly lost action and was pulled up when 400-1 for a 1m AW novice 16 days ago; of little account under NH rules.

RaceName: Signs In Motion British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Weakened at Ffos Las (1m, good), finishing a very remote fifth in a field of eight.

RaceName: Signs In Motion British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Difficult to know what she really acheived when beaten 12l in a four-runner 1m2f novice at Newmarket (good to firm); it would be a big surprise should she topple Bintward.

RaceName: Belvedere House & Gardens Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Four wins over hurdles; C&D chase winner last month, much too strong for Scalpanagoon; ran well to finish fourth in a higher grade in the Galway Blazers; has improved since finishing behind The Dara Man here in May; Dara McGill's 7lb claim is a help.

RaceName: Belvedere House & Gardens Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Three course wins to his name, best form at 2m4f; below-par on last two visits here; however, unwise to rule out given his overall record at this track.

RaceName: Belvedere House & Gardens Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Five-time winner, 2-11 over fences; course winner of a 3m1f handicap hurdle; was staying on at the finish of a 2m4f handicap chase at this venue recently on only his second 2026 start.

RaceName: Belvedere House & Gardens Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Better hurdler than chaser; has won on good ground but seems more effective on soft; may have needed his hurdles run at Galway after a break.

RaceName: Belvedere House & Gardens Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Fortunate to win a Tramore beginners' event in April; ran well in a Market Rasen handicap before a poor run at Perth; bounced back from that when fourth in a handicap chase at Galway.

RaceName: Belvedere House & Gardens Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Two wins over hurdles, maiden chaser; beaten 9l by Charlie Luciano in a C&D beginners' event on penultimate start; 7lb better off, could go close.

RaceName: Belvedere House & Gardens Handicap Chase
Spotlight: His run on the Flat at Galway may have come too soon after a satisfactory hurdles run at the same venue (fourth in a 19-runner 2m6f event); lack of chasing experience is a concern.

RaceName: Belvedere House & Gardens Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Has a good record over hurdles at this venue; has yet to score in 13 starts over fences; pulled up in a handicap hurdle at Galway last time; stablemate The Dara Man is more interesting.

RaceName: Belvedere House & Gardens Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Modest strike-rate of 3-41 over fences, although one of wins was gained at this venue in August 2024 at Kilbeggan; finished in front of Charlie Luciano when third here in May; lying second when falling three out at Killarney; 19lb below his last winning mark.

RaceName: Patersons Of Greenoakhill Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Four-time sprint winner who is ideally suited by good or slower ground; finished down the field in last two starts, but he ran well at Redcar in May and is now back on the same mark as when landing the Ayr Bronze Cup (6f, soft) last autumn; needs a close look back from a short break.

RaceName: Patersons Of Greenoakhill Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Acts on good and soft ground; record of 4-15 and his wins were in handicaps last season, including over C&D; still 8lb higher than for his last success but he was runner-up at Thirsk in April and did best of the pacesetters when fourth at Haydock (7f, good) last time; returns after a break and he's in the mix on this drop back in trip.

RaceName: Patersons Of Greenoakhill Handicap (Div II)
OwnerName: B Jordan, Brian Jordan, S Jordan & N McConnell
Spotlight: Beat 16 rivals when scoring from off the pace at Musselburgh (5f, good to soft) in April; three placed efforts since but he flopped when favourite at Musselburgh last time and that took his record to 1-16; comes with risks attached back up in trip.

RaceName: Patersons Of Greenoakhill Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: His wins have come on slow ground but he was beaten only 3l in a big field at York (7f, good to firm) last month; that was a creditable effort after a slow start and he ran well over this trip at Ayr on his penultimate run; could be dangerous.

RaceName: Patersons Of Greenoakhill Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Well handicapped on his old form but last win was over two years ago and he's been out of sorts this season; this drop back in trip is no problem but he needs a major revival; visor reapplied.

RaceName: Patersons Of Greenoakhill Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Off the mark at the ninth attempt when coming from rear to land a Carlisle handicap (7f, soft) in May; only 1lb higher here but he's been well held in his last two starts and this is his first attempt at a sprint trip; others preferred.

RaceName: Patersons Of Greenoakhill Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Ended lengthy losing run when scoring off reduced mark at Southwell (6f, AW) two weeks ago; back up 5lb but he remains well treated on his best form including a win at Chester (6f, good) last July; interesting contender.

RaceName: Patersons Of Greenoakhill Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Several creditable efforts this summer before getting back on the scoresheet with a strong finish over C&D (good; second-time cheekpieces) last week; this is tougher under a penalty but that was a personal best last time and she should get a good tow into this race; respected.

RaceName: Patersons Of Greenoakhill Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Returned to form when making all at Thirsk (6f, good) in June but he failed to back that up in a Silver Cup trial at Ayr last month; that was another blip in his patchy profile and he needs to bounce back again.

RaceName: Patersons Of Greenoakhill Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: 12-time C&D winner including three this summer; no impact in her last three starts, but her last success was off only 1lb lower and she battled well when landing this race last year; not ruled out.

RaceName: Killarney Towers Hotel & Leisure Centre Apprentice Handicap
OwnerName: Athlumney Farms Ltd & Eoin Baxter & Mrs M D O'Callaghan
Spotlight: Sole success came in Ballinrobe (9.5f, good) claimer last summer; never out of the three in last four handicap starts over a variety of trips; appreciated return to good ground when beaten 1.5l by Fianna three days ago at Roscommon; extra two furlongs no problem and big chance if backing up quickly.

RaceName: Killarney Towers Hotel & Leisure Centre Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Won twice last year, including 1m6f Curragh handicap off 3lb lower in October; has found revised mark beyond him so far this year; blinkers tried.

RaceName: Killarney Towers Hotel & Leisure Centre Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Winner over 1m5f at Navan (good) in June off 11lb lower; followed up with narrow defeat at Bellewstown (split Numidia and Celestially); obvious chance on that form but folded tamely at Leopardstown 29 days ago.

RaceName: Killarney Towers Hotel & Leisure Centre Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Six-time winner, landed successive handicaps at Bellewstown (1m6f) and Down Royal (1m5f, good); 6lb rise and muddling pace found him out at Gowran Park last time; extra distance will help and he can bounce back.

RaceName: Killarney Towers Hotel & Leisure Centre Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Sole success came over this trip on soft ground at Navan in October; solid efforts either side of hurdles run; ground may be too quick.

RaceName: Killarney Towers Hotel & Leisure Centre Apprentice Handicap
OwnerName: Samuel M Mencoff & Anthony Paul Smurfit
Spotlight: Improved switched to handicaps, shaped well here over 1m3f in May before scoring over same C&D 39 days ago, beating Canon Law by 2.5l, who has won since; 9lb higher and longer trip to contend with but leading claims.

RaceName: Killarney Towers Hotel & Leisure Centre Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Steadily improved for handicaps and appreciated ease in the ground last twice when runner-up at Down Royal (1m2f) and Galway (1m6f); well-held both times but was behind very well-handicapped winner at Galway and finished 2.75l ahead of Lady Pimsoll; considered but probably best on ground with a give.

RaceName: Killarney Towers Hotel & Leisure Centre Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Veteran who has scored four times on the turf; latest at Sligo (1m6f, soft) in May off 3lb lower; bit to find with some of these rivals based on Bellewstown run last month and would prefer rain.

RaceName: Killarney Towers Hotel & Leisure Centre Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Has been getting the hang of things in handicaps and is closely matched with a few main rivals based on third at Bellewstown off 5lb lower last month; followed that up with good second over C&D last time and is one of the lesser exposed types in here; likely player.

RaceName: Killarney Towers Hotel & Leisure Centre Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: 0-6 in Britain; well-held on stable debut at Sligo 16 days ago; dropped 4lb but 2lb wrong at the weights here so she has plenty on her plate.

RaceName: Edwards Ford, Foray Motor Group Handicap
Spotlight: Dual-purpose gelding whose sole win came in a 1m6f AW handicap last October off 6lb lower; has performed well under both codes since, last time third of 24 in a handicap hurdle at Punchestown in April; fast ground might not be ideal, so any rain would be a blessing.

RaceName: Edwards Ford, Foray Motor Group Handicap
Spotlight: Uncompetitive in two bumpers and the same in three Flat runs (1m2f-1m3f), though the middle effort at Windsor offered some promise with a view to low-grade handicaps.

RaceName: Edwards Ford, Foray Motor Group Handicap
Spotlight: Better known as a jumper and hasn't won on the Flat since 2023; it's unclear what his latest second here amounts to as only four ran and the odds-on winner bolted up.

RaceName: Edwards Ford, Foray Motor Group Handicap
Spotlight: Much improved to win by 10l at Ffos Las (1m4f, good) and she was a clear second when 4lb well in back there nine days ago; new mark has kicked in but 1m6f might suit; would have questions to answer if conditions went on the soft side of good.

RaceName: Edwards Ford, Foray Motor Group Handicap
Spotlight: A winner over hurdles in July; capable on the Flat off this sort of mark and won at Bath in May; should give a good account; goes on all ground.

RaceName: Edwards Ford, Foray Motor Group Handicap
Spotlight: Second in a field of four when tried over this far three runs back; has since won a 1m2f classified race and finished third in another when penalised; should run well provided his stamina stands the test.

RaceName: John Thomas McNamara Series INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Second foal; Poets Word gelding closely related to 1m winner Yellow Bear; dam 6f/7f winner by Holy Roman Emperor; beaten 20l in third in maiden point this season before last; winner Newbrook Diamond and runner-up Court Compliance have won over hurdles; in good hands.

RaceName: John Thomas McNamara Series INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Three-figure odds when tailed off in a bumper at Cork early this month; can be ruled out.

RaceName: John Thomas McNamara Series INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Fourth foal; half-brother by Idaho to useful staying hurdle/chase winner Inch House; dam is from a family associated with talented jumpers; fell five out at Loughrea 15 months ago on his only point-to-point start.

RaceName: John Thomas McNamara Series INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Respectable effort over C&D, well beaten at Ballinrobe on either side of that; no appeal.

RaceName: John Thomas McNamara Series INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Made no impact when a 4-1 chance for an academy hurdle at Leopardstown last December; big price when down the field in a bumper at Cork last month; held by fourth-placed Hill Silver

RaceName: John Thomas McNamara Series INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Remote fourth behind a Willie Mullins-trained winner on debut at Killarney in May; took a big step in the right direction when taking the same place in a Galway festival bumper; this is a much weaker race; looks the part.

RaceName: John Thomas McNamara Series INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Gelding by Gustav Klimt, dam placed at two, closely related to US 1m4f turf stakes/GB 1m5f AW Listed winner High Heel Sneakers (dam of 1m4f Group 1 winner Sweet Lady); very capable point-to-point rider booked.

RaceName: John Thomas McNamara Series INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Introduced in good company at Galway, finished last of six; this is more realistic at least.

RaceName: John Thomas McNamara Series INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Fell on her sole point-to-point start; completely tailed off in a recent bumper at Wexford; hooded now.

RaceName: John Thomas McNamara Series INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Too keen in her two maiden hurdle outings, pulled up both times; settled a bit better in front for this rider in a bumper at Wexford a fortnight ago and outran her 66-1 odds to finish third behind a Willie Mullins-trained mare; could go close in what looks like a modest contest.

RaceName: John Thomas McNamara Series INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Pulled up on both starts in points; struggled in a Killarney bumper; cheekpieces added now to to tongue-toe worn then.

RaceName: Hemmings Homes 10th Anniversary Handicap
Spotlight: Gained the second of his two C&D wins in June when wearing cheekpieces for the first time (good); well beaten last two starts, but blinkers didn't work on first occasion and he didn't stay 6f at Catterick on Monday; could bounce back.

RaceName: Hemmings Homes 10th Anniversary Handicap
Spotlight: Won an Ayr maiden at 200-1 in June (6f, soft), but has been well beaten in two handicaps since.

RaceName: Hemmings Homes 10th Anniversary Handicap
Spotlight: Bids for a hat-trick after wins at Beverley in May (5f, good to firm) and Ayr in June (5f, soft); up 11lb (5lb rise for last win); each-way chance.

RaceName: Hemmings Homes 10th Anniversary Handicap
Spotlight: Mixed form since C&D win in May (good); better than his last run (carried left at the start), but others make more appeal.

RaceName: Hemmings Homes 10th Anniversary Handicap
Spotlight: Exposed sort; 2lb lower than when winning at Carlisle in March (5f, good) but wasn't at his best at Ayr last time.

RaceName: Hemmings Homes 10th Anniversary Handicap
Spotlight: Got off the mark on turf with a decisive win in a C&D apprentice event last week (good); put up 6lb for that, but able to run off the same mark here; the one to beat.

RaceName: Hemmings Homes 10th Anniversary Handicap
Spotlight: Three wins here, two over this trip, the other over 6f; well beaten when returning from a break last time; not out of it in first-time visor, but ideally needs soft/heavy ground.

RaceName: Hemmings Homes 10th Anniversary Handicap
Spotlight: Has won nine races, two over C&D (good to soft/soft); 3.5l second to Tanjen over C&D last time but meets her on the same terms, so may struggle to turn that form around.

RaceName: Hemmings Homes 10th Anniversary Handicap
Spotlight: Unexposed; 28-1 winner on handicap debut at Musselburgh in June (5f, good), but well beaten at Ayr next time (plenty to find with Startling on that run).

RaceName: Hemmings Homes 10th Anniversary Handicap
Spotlight: Ex-Irish; eight-race maiden; fair run when fourth at Ayr last time (5f, good) in a race in which Startling was 2.5l in front of her in second; fairly unexposed and could turn that form around.

RaceName: Hemmings Homes 10th Anniversary Handicap
Spotlight: Both wins have been over 6f here, the first on good to soft in June, the second on good to firm last month; effective at 5f, but not been in quite such good form recently.

RaceName: Hemmings Homes 10th Anniversary Handicap
Spotlight: C&D winner in September 2024 (good to soft); two wins in 2025, but hasn't shown her best form so far this term; on a good mark as a result, so not out of it.

RaceName: HR Buddy (Q.R.) Race
Spotlight: Unbeaten in two bumpers; fair novice hurdler last season; stylish winner of a 1m7f maiden at Leopardstown last month on his second Flat start; plenty to find with Samui on figures, but has potential to improve his rating and is race-fit

RaceName: HR Buddy (Q.R.) Race
Spotlight: Better known as a smart four-time hurdles winner; good recent form when fourth in the Galway Hurdle off a mark of 132, roughly the same ability as Samui; also a capable Flat performer but his 81 rating makes him 23lb inferior to Samui in this sphere.

RaceName: HR Buddy (Q.R.) Race
Spotlight: Smart dual-purpose sort; well suited by the race conditions; twice ran well in defeat at Royal Ascot last summer, third in the Copper Horse Handicap (1m6f, good to firm) and second in the Queen Alexandra (2m5f, good to firm); not seen since a fine second in a 1m6f Group 3 at York 13 months ago; good opportunity for Hannah Smullen if he returns in prime shape.

RaceName: HR Buddy (Q.R.) Race
OwnerName: Michael J Mulligan & Patrick G Walsh
Spotlight: Handicap hurdle winner on debut for this yard at Ballinrobe in May; made a pleasing Flat debut when a strong-finishing second to an odds-on shot in a 1m4f Bellewstown amateur riders' event early last month; finished in mid-field in a handicap hurdle at Galway.

RaceName: HR Buddy (Q.R.) Race
Spotlight: Smart Flat pedigree; looked good when justifying short odds on debut in Listowel bumper in September 2023 (good); failed to build on that twice afterwards on softer ground; absent from December 2023 until tailed off in a 1m4f maiden at the Galway festival.

RaceName: HR Buddy (Q.R.) Race
Spotlight: Showed early promise in bumpers; has never delivered on that; tailed off twice recently.

RaceName: HR Buddy (Q.R.) Race
Spotlight: Placed once from 17 starts over hurdles, weak Flat form, can be left out of calculations

RaceName: HR Buddy (Q.R.) Race
Spotlight: Low-rated gelding with poor handicap form; no apparent chance.
